sidebarCard.whatsappMessage: Hi! I have a question about Fujairah Creative City Free Zone.

items.q: Is it possible to set up an FCC business from outside the UAE?
items.a: Yes. FCC allows startups to operate remotely. The process is mostly completed online or via Power of Attorney (POA), letting you conduct business in your absence.

items.q: How many visas can I get with my FCC license?
items.a: Visa quotas depend on your license package and office type. We help you choose the right combination.

items.q: Is this a viable option for freelancers?
items.a: Absolutely. FCC is one of the most freelancer-friendly Free Zones with cost-effective Freelancer Licenses and no-office packages.

items.q: Do I have to rent an office to obtain the license?
items.a: No. FCC offers no-office packages, so you can operate legally as a remote operation without renting physical space.

items.q: Can I upgrade or change my business activity at a later date?
items.a: Yes. FCC allows activity amendments and upgrades. We handle the process for you.

items.q: What documentation do I require to register?
items.a: Passport copies, passport-size photos, proposed business names, and an active email/contact number. We guide you through every document.

items.q: How quickly is the setup process?
items.a: Typically 3-7 business days with all documents ready.

items.q: Is FCC suitable for e-commerce or digital services?
items.a: Yes. FCC supports e-commerce support services, digital marketing, and tech businesses with flexible licensing.

items.q: Can I have support with banking and VAT?
items.a: Yes. We provide bank account assistance and VAT registration as part of our post-setup support.
Yes. FCC is a UAE government-backed Free Zone recognized globally.
